scripts.build: node prisma/prepare-postgres.mjs && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma && next build
scripts.vercel-build: node prisma/prepare-postgres.mjs && prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma && node scripts/migrate-if-postgres.mjs && next build
scripts.db:migrate:dev: node prisma/prepare-postgres.mjs && prisma migrate dev --schema prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: node prisma/prepare-postgres.mjs && prisma migrate deploy --schema prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma
scripts.db:migrate:status: node prisma/prepare-postgres.mjs && prisma migrate status --schema prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma
